{{Quote|Legends say there's a lost city of the Ghorfas out there somewhere, but anybody that's gone looking for it ain't come back.|An old mechanic|<ref name="LCOT" />}}
'''The lost city of the Ghorfas''' was an ancient [[City/Legends|city]] built around the [[Desolation Canyons]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] millennia before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The city was abandoned around [[4200 BBY]], when [[Human/Legends|human]] colonists deprived the native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Ghorfas]] of their [[Water/Legends|water]] supplies. Around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the city was in ruins and considered a legend.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|But those ruins over there look just like the slave ruins in the old villages, and the mechanic said the Ghorfas built those.|Biggs Darklighter|<ref name="LCOT" />}}
The Lost City was built into a cliff wall located near the [[Desolation Canyons]], on the [[Star/Legends|sun]]-scorched [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It consisted of a giant stepped structure surrounded by numerous terraces of round or square adobe dwellings. Ancient [[Water/Legends|water]] wells were surrounded by heavy stone walls.<ref name="LCOT" /> The city's architecture was very similar to that of the [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|slave quarters]] of the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Lines of [[Burial/Legends|tombstones]] lay at the foot of the front steps.<ref name="LCOT" />

==History==
{{Quote|Uh, Biggs, look at this. It's the Lost City of the Ghorfas!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="LCOT" />}}
[[File:Ghorfa_tomb_and_Skywalker.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Luke Skywalker discovering a Ghorfa tombstone]]
Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tatooine was inhabited by two [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|races]], the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Ghorfas]]<ref name="LCOT" /> and the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], who both descended from the [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]] species.<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> The Ghorfas were a sedentary people and competent builders. One of their settlements, later known as the Lost City of the Ghorfas, was built in the vicinity of the Desolation Canyons.<ref name="LCOT" /> Around [[4200 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> when [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers stole all their water, many of the city builders [[Death/Legends|died]] of thirst. The Ghorfas were forced to become nomadic, transforming into the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]], who lived an uneasy peace with the Human [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] of Tatooine. Many hovels built by the Ghorfas were turned into [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] quarters by the founders of the old towns.<ref name="LCOT" />

Three years [[3 BBY/Legends|before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his friend [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] accidentally rediscovered the city. The two Humans were headed for the city of [[Metameur]], and they halted at the [[Douz outpost]] when their [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] needed a power charge. The old [[Technician/Legends|Technician]] of the power station advised Skywalker and his friend not to pass through the Desolation Canyons lest they run into a group of Sand People warriors. The man also told them about the legendary lost city of the Ghorfas, who was thought to be somewhere in the vicinity.<ref name="LCOT" />

[[File:Digescap.jpg|thumb|220px|Skywalker and Darklighter fleeing Tusken Raiders.]]
However, Skywalker and Darklighter chose not to heed the technician's warning, and got caught into a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] on their way to Metameur. Trying to escape the storm, the young men incidentally took refuge within the walls of the lost city. While exploring the place, the two Humans found many tombs engraved with [[Ghorfa petroglyphs|ancient petroglyphs]]. When Skywalker tried to interprete the ancient writing on the tombstones, he understood the Ghorfas were in fact the ancestors of the Sand People, forced to abandon their city and adopt nomadic ways when colonists exhausted their water wells. Luke Skywalker intended to spread the news all over Tatooine, but his uncle [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] forbade him to do so, arguing that the past was best left alone.<ref name="LCOT" />
